items.recorded: 12 May 1968, Smetana Hall, Municipal House, Prague (Prague Spring concert)
items.label: Supraphon
items.note: Ančerl conducted the whole cycle at the Prague Spring festival of 1968; Supraphon’s own channel carries the Vltava section as a video. The film credits Bohumil Čipera as recording director.
